name: Superconduction / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A clean crystalline bone break with an icy electrical chirp, followed by fine crystalline ticks and sustained high cold electrical singing that fades downward. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
